name: com.8izips.fmath
description: Deterministic fixed-point math for rollback netcode: integer-only HPC# kernels with Burst scalar and batch entry points. 32-bit state (ffloat Q16.16, funit Q1.30, fAngle Angle32), 64-bit intermediates. Requires Unity 6.6 and built-in Burst 2.

samples.description: Requires copying Tests~/Diagnostics to Assets/fMathDiagnostics first. MonoBehaviour that prints the raw-hash, 10000-tick simulation hash and benchmarks on a device build (Windows / Android / iOS IL2CPP).
